lemmas.name: maj35
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (h : majorityElement_precond nums), majorityElement_postcond nums ((nums.find? (fun x => decide (nums.count x > nums.length / 2))).getD 0) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums h
  unfold majorityElement_postcond
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hc, hu⟩ := Refine.find_majority nums h.2
  rw [show (nums.find? (fun x => decide (nums.count x > nums.length / 2))).getD 0 = r from hr]
  exact ⟨hc, hu⟩
